reasons.author: AD-xcheck
reasons.why: AD style lock: hat cuff = oat_1/oat_2 only. Mauve appeared on the hat cuff only in squash/drop frames (f2/f8/f9, f11 S end), read as a lilac headband and blinked against neighbours; S f2 was already fixed this way by pixel-SN, so the other directions now match.

reasons.author: AD-xcheck
reasons.why: AD style lock: coat is char_1 + ink, no lav_1. lav_1 slivers were already removed in S/N/SW; here they blinked on/off frame to frame (NE on in f2-5,7,9,11, off in f1,6,8,10,12; E only in f9).
